summary: Clearwater County, ID site developed 1921 with towers from 1934; the west-point tower was gone by 1957 and the east-point tower by 1962. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab on the east point (1934); sources disagree on the west-point tower
facts.status_note: East-point tower destroyed or removed in 1962; west-point tower destroyed or removed in 1957

staffing.status: no named lookout in the sources read; not staffed during the fire season before the 1962 removal

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site Drive-Up, listed as destroyed; no source says whether the public can reach it today

corrections.why: The TPA annual report quoted on the Forest Lookouts page says the tower was removed in the fall of 1962 after going unstaffed during the fire season. None of the sources says it was abandoned in place.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1962; the TPA report quoted on the Forest Lookouts page says a tower was removed in the fall of 1962 but does not name the point. All give 1962, so the date is settled. The story attributes 'destroyed' to the east-point tower as the two sources state it, and says the Forest Lookouts report does not name the point.
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed; the TPA report quoted on the Forest Lookouts page says the 110-foot tower was removed. All three give 1957, so the date is settled.

notes_for_editor: Sources agree on the 1921 development, the 1923 cabin and the 1934 east-point L-4 tower. For the west-point tower, Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Lookouts 1934 entry all give a 100-foot pole L-6 built in 1934. The Forest Lookouts page also quotes a June 1944 note about poles for a 110-foot tower which it says was erected on the west point. The height and erection date of the west-point tower are not settled from the sources read. The TPA annual reports (1957-58, 1961-62) are known only as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the originals were not read. Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site Drive-Up (Drive-Up Destroyed), recorded in facts.visit, but no source describes the site today or says whether it can be reached now; the brief's access unknown stands.
